nodes.summary: For $f\colon \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ and real $r$, the normalized spherical area $A(f, r)$ of $f$ on the disk $|z| < r$ is $\frac{1}{\pi}$ times the Lebesgue integral of the spherical density of $f$ over the open disk $\{z \in \mathbb{C} : |z| < r\}$ (the integral is taken to be $0$ if the density is not integrable there).
nodes.title: Normalized spherical area

nodes.summary: Not every function $f\colon \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ that is meromorphic on all of $\mathbb{C}$ and nonconstant (complex differentiable at two points where it takes different values) has bounded root counts and satisfies $\liminf_{r \to \infty} n(f, r)/A(f, r) = 1$, where $n(f, r)$ is the maximum valence and $A(f, r)$ the normalized spherical area of $f$ on the disk $|z| < r$.
nodes.title: Hayman's spherical-area ratio conjecture is false

nodes.summary: The statement that every function $f\colon \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ that is meromorphic on all of $\mathbb{C}$ and nonconstant (complex differentiable at two points where it takes different values) has bounded root counts (for every real $r$, the numbers of roots of $f(z) = a$ in $|z| < r$, counted with multiplicity, are bounded above as $a$ ranges over $\mathbb{C}$) and satisfies
nodes.title: Hayman's spherical-area ratio conjecture

nodes.summary: A function $f\colon \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ has bounded root counts if for every real $r$ the root counts of $f$ in radius $r$, that is, the numbers of roots of $f(z) = a$ in $|z| < r$ counted with multiplicity, are bounded above as $a$ ranges over $\mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: Bounded root counts

nodes.summary: A function $f\colon \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ is nonconstant if there are points $u, v \in \mathbb{C}$ at which $f$ is complex differentiable and $f(u) \ne f(v)$.
nodes.title: Germ-wise nonconstant function

nodes.summary: For $f\colon \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ and real $r$, $n(f, r)$ is the supremum in $\mathbb{R}$, over all $a \in \mathbb{C}$, of the root count of $f$ at $a$ in radius $r$, that is, of the number of roots of $f(z) = a$ in $|z| < r$ counted with multiplicity.
nodes.title: Maximum valence

nodes.summary: For $f\colon \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$, $a \in \mathbb{C}$ and real $r$, the root count of $f$ at $a$ in radius $r$ is the number of roots of $f(z) = a$ in the open disk $|z| < r$, counted with multiplicity: the sum over $z \in \mathbb{C}$ of the positive part of the divisor of $f - a$ on that disk at $z$ (the sum is taken to be $0$ if infinitely many terms are nonzero).
nodes.title: Root count

nodes.summary: For $f\colon \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ and $z \in \mathbb{C}$, the spherical density of $f$ at $z$ is $|f'(z)|^2 / (1 + |f(z)|^2)^2$, where $f'(z)$ is the complex derivative of $f$ at $z$, taken to be $0$ where $f$ is not differentiable.
nodes.title: Spherical density
